~1.0 hr/axle for pads alone per flat-rate consensus; 1.5 covers seized slides/electronic calipers.

Comparable to front; EPB retraction adds time on 2013+ vehicles.

Most vehicles 1-2 hr; buried/intake-under thermostats to 2.5. Coolant handling and bleed on a driveway is workable but messy.
1.5-4.0 hr typical; 1.9 hr cited from Mitchell flat rate on a common application. Front-end disassembly designs go to a shop.

Access-driven; includes refill and bleed.

Bolt-on intake-tract part; low variance.

Only applies to vehicles that still have a serviceable filter; in-tank filter-sock jobs are a fuel-pump job.
1.5-2.5 easy access via seat/floor panel; 3-5 hr on trucks and dual-pump systems requiring tank drop. Fuel-tank drop on jack stands is a shop job.

2-4 hr and requires a hydraulic press. Refuse mobile; triage to shop.

1.0-3.5 hr commonly billed; 1.9 hr cited from a flat-rate guide for an R&R. Requires alignment after.

Quick job but mandates an alignment; quote as job + alignment referral.

1.2-1.8 on FWD with good access; AWD and trucks higher. Axle-nut torque and hub separation are the constraints without a lift.
